head: 利慧
target: theg pa chen po'i chos la gong nas gong du 'phar zhing phyir mi ldog pa dang / rno ba'i shes rab dang / bsod nams kyi khyad par rtag tu skye zhing 'phel ba dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs dang / bzod pa dang / sa rnams thams cad la dbang du 'gyur zhing phyir mi ldog pa dang / rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad cing rjes su 'gro bar 'gyur ba dang / rtag tu sangs rgyas thams cad mthong ba dang mi 'bral zhing byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos kyi nye gnas mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba dang / chos thos pa dang mi 'bral ba dang / dge 'dun la mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur byed pa dang mi 'bral ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad tshol ba la brtson pas sems mi ngoms pa dang / byang chub kyi spyod pa dang smon lam rnam pa sna tshogs kyis sems mi ngoms par 'gyur te/
